parameters.query:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_delivery_mode' THEN value END) AS default_delivery_mode,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_test_recipient' THEN value END) AS default_test_recipient,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_sender_name' THEN value END) AS email_sender_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_reply_to' THEN value END) AS email_reply_to,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_signature_template_key' THEN value END) AS default_signature_template_key,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'template_key', et.template_key,
        'template_name', COALESCE(NULLIF(et.template_name, ''), et.template_key)
      )
      ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(et.template_name, ''), et.template_key)
    )
    FROM public.email_templates et
    WHERE et.is_active = true
      AND et.template_type = 0
  ), '[]'::json) AS message_templates,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'template_key', et.template_key,
        'template_name', COALESCE(NULLIF(et.template_name, ''), et.template_key)
      )
      ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(et.template_name, ''), et.template_key)
    )
    FROM public.email_templates et
    WHERE et.is_active = true
      AND et.template_type = 2
  ), '[]'::json) AS signature_templates
FROM public.global_settings
WHERE key IN (
  'email_delivery_mode',
  'email_test_recipient',
  'email_sender_name',
  'email_reply_to',
  'email_signature_template_key'
);
